inputs.description: Roll back to this tag (everything applied after it is undone)
Number of changesets to roll back

tasks.label: docker: build + checks
tasks.detail: Build the migration image. Fails on a missing rollback, a duplicate id, an orphan file or an invalid changelog

tasks.label: migrate: update (up)
tasks.detail: Apply every pending changeset, including dev sample data
tasks.command: docker compose up -d --wait db; docker compose run --rm --build migrate update

tasks.label: migrate: preview update SQL
tasks.detail: Print the SQL that update would run, without running it

tasks.label: migrate: rollback to tag (down)
tasks.detail: Undo every changeset applied after a tag

tasks.label: migrate: preview rollback SQL
tasks.detail: Print the SQL a rollback to a tag would run, without running it

tasks.label: verify: round trip
tasks.detail: Up, down to baseline, up again on a throwaway database
tasks.command: docker compose --profile verify run --rm --build verify; docker compose --profile verify rm -sf verify-db

tasks.label: db: reset
tasks.detail: Delete the local database and apply everything again
tasks.command: docker compose down -v; docker compose up -d --wait db; docker compose run --rm --build migrate update
